book.name: Mark
book.title: Mark ka Te Pabe'e Jesus, Te Naa Tooa'a-witu, Numu oo Tuukwena

content: Mooa yongona oetu, o'nosoo te manena te natzama'wukwuna soomayuna, yise ewa tukakwu, ka Gi Namayuadu Tukaba tukakwu. Soo Jew numu tutunehanedu ka Te Pabe'e watze nesootze'ma mee yise, “How sakwa tamme ka Jesus watze tzakadu tabuase, oo batsa?
Tamme sakwa gi numu poonnena oo batsapana, mu numu tamme-no nagoedooa.”

Soo Te Pabe'e ka Bethany-wi ka Simon Tookoo Pehe mee naneadu nobe-kwi. Mu tukawunu, sumu'yoo mogo'ne oe petuoo. Ka tupe osa-witu ka besa kwanadu nakwana'a gwuuna. Ka osa tsabadowse, ka Te Pabe'e kwo-kooba oo tuoonahoo.
Susumudu mu Te Pabe'e-batu ka mogo'ne manena nesootu'adya'e, “Oosoo sakwa gi oo nahadyagwepana ka besa kwanadu nakwana'a oosoo ewa nanenagadu. Oosoo sakwa oo-ma tumuse mu tutuha manedu namadea.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo mu netamma, “A tsasoopedya. Gi a nesootu'adya'epana. Esoo mogo'ne besa manakwe.
Mu tutuha manedu tooe hannano'o pana ooosapa mu-no'yookwu, pana nu gi ooosapa mu-no'yookwu.
Soo mogo'ne manena dea'a, e natugukwu-kwitoo a natumayohona.
Tooe hano tooe ka teepu kaa'no, ka besa nayadooadu-kwi esoo mogo'ne manepu saa'a nanatugwengadooa. Oo-makoo tamme nanasoomayudooa.”
Sumu'yoo mu Te Pabe'e nakatzimodu-matu Judas Iscariot mee naneadu ka mu Jew numu tutunehanedu-baa petuse mee mu netamma, “Nu oo sopedakwatoo ka Ne Pabe'e pukwi'yoona nu sumuna mu tuukwekwu.”
Mu tutunehanedu besa sokwama ka oo nakase umu yise ka Judas tumasumudooku. Soo Judas yise meeoo soonamme, “Hownnekoo sakwa nu ka Te Pabe'e-matoo mu bika?”
Yaa tabeno numme ka seepu tooa'a batsakwu, ka gi namayuadu tukaba noko oo ewa tukakwuse mu oo nakatzimodu yise ka Te Pabe'e tubenga, “Hano'yoona sakwa tamme ewa tuka?”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise waahoo mu tunakatzimodu-matu tayase. Mee mu netamma, “Ka nana baa tzanodu mu saa'a wegeadooa.

Mu saa'a ookow nageakadooa. Ka nobe-kwi oo egeakase oo-nosoo saa'a tzoonooahookwatese ka nana nobe-gakoo mee netamma, ‘Soo Te Pabe'e umu pumme nakatzimodu-no yaa u-baa'yoona nanesootuhi yongo tukakwu.’
Esoo nana nobe-ga'yoo yise mu tzapoonnekukwu, ka pa'atu nobe-kwi'yoona ka tukapu mu yonga tukakwuna mu saadooa.”
Mu waha'yoo yise memea, ka Te Pabe'e unne-toosoo manekwuse.
Ka tu yongose Te Pabe'e umu tunakatzimodu-no ka nobe-kwi petuga.
Umu-no tukanasoo, Te Pabe'e mee unakwe, “Sumu'yoo mu-matu nu-no tukadu ka mu tukwutumadu nu-matoo bikekwu, umu yise e batsakwu.”
Mu Te Pabe'e nakatzimodu oo nakase, suda nuummana, umu nanasusu'mu'yoona mee unakwe, “Nu haa'a?”
Soo Te Pabe'e mu nekwegea, “Sumu'yoo mu-nagatu nu-no tukadu.
Too'e soo Te Naa mooasoo, ‘U nabatsakwu,’ mee tunetammapana, saa'a oosoo umu e wohomu nu-matoo bikepu tuma'emukwana oo-matoosoo kodyukwu.”
Mu tuka, soo Te Pabe'e tukaba gwuuhoose, oo-koobatoo nanesootuhise oo tzaboka. Yise umu tunakatzimodu hemese ooka mu tuka tuungu, mee unnena, “Esoo puu nuga tookoo-wa'ne'yoosoo.”
Yise ka besow atsa baa yoongase oo-koobatoo nanesootuhise, ooka mu hebe tuungu.
Soo Te Pabe'e mee'e unnena, “Esoo puu nuga puupe-wa'ne'yoosoo. Te Naa Toogoopatu besa unnena tunetammana, suda mu manepu-koobatoo e nabatsakwuse.
Nu mu tuukwe'e nu ekow atsa baa ka yaa teepu-koobatu tubetse gi hebekwusoo, saa'a ka Te Naa ka te teepu mapudutupudoose, o'no yise nu tubetse pudutupusoo hebekwu.”
Umu yise nanesootuhi hoobea nekwuna ka Olive mee naneadu tuutsekoo giba-matoo mea'a.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise mee ne netamma, “Ka yaa togano suda tu namanikwuse mu e ma'wuookakwu. O'nosoo soo Te Naa yadooawabe mee'e tubotugupu, mee'e na'unakwe ka meno'o Te Pabe'e manekwuna.

content.text: ‘Soo seepu takonedu nabatsahookwu, mu seepu yise nana'emota petugwahookwu.’

content: Nu saa'a e ya'ekwukoo namayodase, Galilee-witoo mu-kobenasoo meadooa. Mu saa'a, o nu-baa petugadooa.”
Soo Peter meeoo ka Te Pabe'e netamma, “Mu u nakatzimodu sumuna u-kooba'yoona mea'akwu, nu gi umu-no meakwu.”
Soo Te Pabe'e meeoo ka Peter netamma, “Togesoo tu toganopunne, ka tsekana kwu'a gisoo wahadooe oo yaka, u pahedooe oona numu tuukwekwu u gi e sopedakwatoo mee.”
Soo Peter yise meeoo Te Pabe'e netamma, “Tooe umu e batsakwu mee unnepana nu gi meeoo unne-wa'ne'yoo, ka gi u-ma nasookwina.” Mu Te Pabe'e nakatzimodu no'yoona oo-wa'nesoo unakwe.
Ka Olive namasu'a-wi petuse, Gethsemane mee naneadu, soo Te Pabe'e mu tunakatzimodu mee netamma, “Yowsoo aatapunne. Nu nanesootuhigakwu.”
Mu Peter, James, John oo-no mea'a.
Soo Te Pabe'e mee mu netamma, “E pewu-kwitu tubetse suda nuumma. Mu sakwa yaahoosoo aatapunne.”
Soo Te Pabe'e sagwane umu kwinga'atoosoo meahoose, o ka teepu-kooba meatzedose, yise nanesootuhikooha.
“E Naa Toogoopatu. Nuga Naa Toogoopatu. Nuka u tunetammakuse nu oo-toogoo meakwu. Ekow e pewu-kwitu suda nuummana, kadoo'oo mayugwe.” Soo Te Pabe'e ka nanesootuhimakwuse
tu pupua'amu utua'e mu mayu petuga. Soo Te Pabe'e mee mu netamma, “How mu tubetse unu utuigapu-ga'yoo?” Soo Te Pabe'e ka Peter meeoo netamma, “U sakwa gi uwepana.”
No'oko yise meeoo netamma, “Mu sakwa nanesootuhi aata o'no soo suta'yoo gi mu matzama. Mu gi oo mapu'a ka gi manese mee'e nu.”
Soo Te Pabe'e yise penakwa nanesootuhigase ka mooe'ugasoo tu nanesootuhi-kwa'nekoosoo nanesootuhi.
Yise tu pupua'amu-baa kodyu petuse, mu utua'e mu mayu petusoo.

Yise nanesootuhigasoo tuwazoo saa'a umu-baasoo kodyu petu, tooesoo mu utua'e. Soo Te Pabe'e yise meeoo mu netamma, “Yow haa'a mu togesoo utua'e? Yosuhoo, tamme mea'akwu, meno'o oe mani petu, nu natzakwenekwu. Yaa soo suta'yoo nana kemma.”

Ka Te Pabe'e togesoo yadoo'a, Judas petuoo, mu Jew numu tutunehanedu mu tukwutumadu taya ka Judas noko. Pabatze'ekoo koodoo'oo noko tsegesa hemana. Soo Judas, ka Te Pabe'e-matoo tooe. Soo Judas yise oo-no namitzadya'me o'no umu oo sopedakwatoo.
Umu yise ka Te Pabe'e-ma tsakatu.
Sumu'yoo umu Te Pabe'e nakatzimodu-matu yise tsegesa-ma ka mu Jew numu tunehanedu pabe'e tummatzidu naka wuga'akwunihoo.
Soo Te Pabe'e yise ka mu tukwutumadu meeoo netamma, “Nu gi suda tumatugudu, gi nu naduyadu, gi tuduhadu tuwazoo. Gi sakwa mu koodoo'oo-ma e tumahepana, tsegesa-ma tuwazoo.
Tooe ka e nanesootuhi nobe-kwikoo sapa, mu gi nu-ma tzakadupu-ga'yoo. Muusoo too'e. Mooasoo soo tubope ebeoo nabotuku, o'nosoo Te Naa tamme tuukwe-kwa'nesoo.”
Mu Te Pabe'e nakatzimodu oo-ma su'ise, ka Te Pabe'e-baa'yoona namabetugwahoo.
Nu ka tooebetsena, ka Te Pabe'e nagwuuhoose, naga'apu-wi wunaga'a yaahoose ka Te Pabe'e-nakwi meano'o.
Umu tukwutumadu e naga'apu-ma tsakatu, nu yise e naga'apu makwumahoose namameow.
Umu yise ka Te Pabe'e na'enakwakoo oo puta-ma tzakaduse, ka Jew numu pabe'e-matu oo tsakaka. Umu tutunehanedu oo nehanekwu.
Soo Peter kwinga'a mu nakwi me'a, ka Jew numu pabe'e nobe-kobena petugase, o yooekatu.
Soo Jew numu pabe'e ka mu tutunehanedu-no ka Te Pabe'e too'e batsakwuse, gi toge oo manena too'e nemayupana gi hemma nemama'yu.
Susumudu nanana oo manena too'e wahana sukwe esago'e. Umu too'e tuukwepana kadoo'oo hee, tubetse gi hemma nemama'yu.
“Numme meeoo oo unakwe oo naka, ‘Nu ka nobe, ka Te Naa-matoo pukwi'yoona te nanesootuhina kadoo'oo mesoo mayugwe, yise pahe tabeba-wi oo mesoo mayota.’ ”
Mu naana gi nanakwa'nesoo unakwe.
Soo Jew numu pabe'e umu-kobena'yoona ka Te Pabe'e tubenga, “Togesapa haa'a umu nanana meeoo u netamma?”
Soo Te Pabe'e tubetse gi hiyoo unakwe. Soo Jew numu pabe'e yise mee oo tubenga, “U haa'a Te Pabe'e? U haa'a toogoopatu Te Naa Tooa?”
Soo Te Pabe'e mee oo nanekwegea, “Aha, mu oe'yoopana e poonnekwu, nu Te Naa Toogoopatu-kumaba katukwu. Saa'a nu koomeba-naga petuookwu, o'no yise mu e pooha poonnekwu.”
Soo Jew numu pabe'e yise tubetse unu sutahoose tu kwasu tsakebu'ehoo, mee mu netamma, “Oosoo suda unakwe ka Te Naa-wa'ne'yoo mee naneyugwena. Gi tamme manatusoo oetusoo wahakwutu sookwa'e.
Mu oo naka ka suda oo unakwe mu sakwa hayoo oetu netamma. Ha'yoo mu sokwama?” Mu numu tutunehanedu mee oo netamma, “Tamme sakwa oo batsa.”
Yise o kobitoo toohegonno, o pooe kwudumowse, oo wupageta, mee yise oo netamma, “Ne tuukwe ka pooha-gana, haga u wupageta?” Mu tutukwutumadu oo-ma tzakaduse, yise oo koba mabatseoo.

Soo Peter yise ka Jew numu tunehanedu naa nobe-kobena pedana oe yooekatu. Sumu'yoo tsuadumu ka Jew numu tunehanedu naa hemma how yugwegudu, ka Peter meeoo netamma, “U haa'a yise ka Jesus nakatzimodu-matu?” mee.
Soo Peter mee oo nanekwegea, “Nu gi oo sopedakwatoo.” Soo Peter meeowse ka natzakwona'a kumabu wunu.
Soo tsuadumu ka mu numu o konnodu meeoo netamma, “Esoo nana ka Jesus nakatzimodu-matu.”
Soo Peter ka mu numu-ma unu su'ina punno'o mee oo netamma, “Gi nu.” Pudusoo mu numu o toonoobatu meeoo oo netamma, “U tookwa togesapa yow ka Jesus nakatzimodu-matu. U ka Galilee-witu.”
Soo Peter meeoo mu netamma, “Gi nu mu numu nemooagadu, nu gi umu-matu.”
Yise tsekana kwu'a waha yaga. Soo Peter ka Te Pabe'e pumme netammana soomayuse, suda soonammena, yagakooha.
